tips.text: /clear gives you a fresh car. Stand clear of the closing doors.
Car getting crowded? /compact squeezes the conversation down so there's room to stretch.
/context shows how crowded the car is.
/resume picks up a ride you left earlier, right where you got off.
Shift+Tab changes how you ride: plan the trip first, or let edits through on their own.
Esc stops Claude mid-turn. No emergency brake required.
With an empty prompt, Esc twice rewinds the line to an earlier stop.
Start a message with ! to run a shell command without leaving your seat.
@ a file to bring it along for the ride.
/btw asks a quick side question without adding it to the ride.
Put the house rules in CLAUDE.md so every ride starts on the right line.
/theme swaps between Subway Seat, Tunnel and Enamel. Same seats, different light.
/model switches trains. Opus for the long haul, Haiku for a hop.
/usage shows the fare so far and how much of your pass is left.
No rush. The next train is always right behind this one.
